title: Tunisian simple stitch throw blanket
excerpt: A beginner-friendly Tunisian crochet blanket in dk yarn. The simple stitch creates a dense, flat fabric with a distinctive woven look.
sourceNotes: Tunisian simple stitch is the foundational Tunisian crochet technique, widely documented across crochet references.

glossaryTerms.definition: The most basic Tunisian stitch. Insert the hook under the vertical bar of each stitch, pick up a loop, then work all loops off together on the return pass.
The first half of each Tunisian row. The hook moves across from right to left, picking up one loop per stitch and leaving them all on the hook.
The second half of each Tunisian row. The hook works off loops two at a time from left to right without turning the work.
A slip stitch row worked through each vertical bar to create a firm, neat edge that matches the look of the foundation chain.

crochet.gaugeText: 16 sts x 14 rows = 10 x 10 cm in Tunisian simple stitch.

16 sts x 14 rows = 10 x 10 cm in Tunisian simple stitch.

Chain 161. Foundation forward pass: insert hook in 2nd ch from hook, pull up loop; repeat across. (161 loops on hook.) Foundation return pass: ch 1, (yo, pull through 2 loops) across until 1 loop remains.

Row forward pass: skip first vertical bar, insert hook under next vertical bar, pull up loop; repeat across, inserting hook through both loops of last st. (161 loops on hook.) Row return pass: ch 1, (yo, pull through 2 loops) across until 1 loop remains. Repeat body row until blanket measures 130 cm from foundation.
row: slip stitch through each vertical bar across. Fasten off.
Weave in all ends with the tapestry needle. Block flat to measurements if the yarn is superwash or cotton.
